I wear it now all the time, and really appreciate it. Particularly, while working at my computer. The material is cut such that it covers from the top of my head, down my back, to below my rear and the long wings of the blanket totally cover my arms and extend below and warm my knees when I am seated at the computer or my desk, piano, etc. The hood is so large that I can double it back on itself, providing even more warmth. I don't bother with the buttons under the arm pits, as they're not necessary and it's easier to put the cloak on and off. I treat the item as a hooded shawl more than as a jacket. I love the pockets as hand warmers. My hands are always cold and interfere with typing accuracy, as well as feeling miserable. A few minutes of putting my hands in the conveniently-placed front pockets, and my hands are warm. Something that has never happened with any other jacket that I have worn. There's something about the manufacture of the material that really holds the body warmth in. Whatever. I love this item. I'm going to buy two more. I can't imagine not wearing this item in the future in my house, which stays cool even in the summer. I also look forward to keeping my propane bill down this winter. I really appreciate the hood, which keeps my head and neck, shoulders and arms, actually my entire torso, warm and toasty. I can honestly say this is the best $25 I ever spent on an item of clothing. products.search_term: Alo Yoga Rain Or Shine Long Coat

reviews.title: They thought of everything!
reviews.body:
It runs so big! I am normally a large, but I will be returning it to get a medium. I have a large head and this hood was very big on me and flopped over my face. Good if you have voluminous hair, perhaps.

Let’s address this early: the jacket does not come with a carrying pack; it folds up into its own left pocket and THAT is the carrying pack! Genius design. The pocket has a little carrying strap and a double sided zipper so that it can be closed from the outside or the inside. To fold: zip up the jacket and lay it flat right side up, fold the arms across the chest and fold the hood down at the neck. Fold the whole jacket in half so that front+sleeves+hood are on the outside. Fold in thirds. Flip over and the left front pocket will be in the center. Proceed to stuff into pocket, turning pocket inside out in the process. It’s a tight fit but it becomes easier with practice.

They thought of everything with this jacket. The upper back is sheer breathable mesh underneath the waterproof panel. The wrists, waist, and hood are adjustable. The hood has a flexible visor that can be folded back if needed, and the hood can be rolled up and stored in a narrow Velcro panel at the base of the neck. Plenty of length - the jacket reached my knees. Reflector patterns. Soft, stylish, lightweight, comfortable, well-made.

It does sound crunchy like a classic windbreaker, but not obnoxiously so.

I wish this jacket came in more colors that are on the muted side instead of stark black and bright pink and blue.

reviews.title: A beautiful oversize coat
reviews.body:

reviews.body:
Truly, these are incredible and lulu dupes. 3mo post partum c section and I was looking for leggings that gave me a little support and a lot of coverage for nursing and that didn’t cut in or put pressure on my abdomen in any way - iykyk.

These. Are. It.

The waist truly is higher than normal and is two layers of material around the midsection so it gives you a gentle hug feeling but not super tight like compression. What I like most is that the part of the material that goes around the middle is one continue piece of fabric that folds over the top and back down to the waist - so no elastic band at the top that cuts in funny or folds over. This allows them to stay up and not ride down too - I never have to adjust these to keep them up and with chasing two kiddos all day, that’s a big deal. They also cover my midsection enough when nursing that I don’t feel the need to wear nursing specific tops to cover my midsection. The material is soft and not see through and dog hair and lint does not stick to it. They can certainly be dressed up or down and have become the leggings I always reach for.

I’m 5.6 height and about 155lbs and the large 28in length fit perfectly! I could have made the 25in work but I prefer the longer length on leggings.

products.search_term: Athleta All About Vertical Crossbody Bag

reviews.body: Love this bag. I wanted one that was large enough to comfortably hold everything I need, but small enough that it was easy to carry around daily. This is perfect. Plenty of pockets, good quality and looks super cute.

This is a great overall little cross-body bag. I am constantly on the look out for a good weekend errands kind of bag. I don't like being weighed down by a large purse, but I do understand the need to have a way to carry around the daily basic necessities, like cell phone, wallet, keys, etc. But I am SUPER hard on purses. I tend to beat them up easily, so I tend to look for more cost-effective options in case I destroy it. This bag ticks all the boxes for me. The basic black color is obviously super versatile, so it goes with everything and can even carry you over into a night out. It is very light weight, which I love. It is not huge, but it is not tiny. It has an efficient main compartment that actually stores more than I had thought it would. I easily have enough room for cell, wallet, cash, phone charger, reading glasses, keys, and other basics like a travel size headache medicine and lip gloss. I like that it has various pockets and zippers to keep me organized. The zippers run very smoothly and easily, which is a big plus when you are going into the bag frequently, like when running errands. It would also be great for travel, in that it can smush down pretty small to carry in your luggage (due to bag number limitations on planes) and then you can pull it out and have a handy purse at your destination without worrying about ruining it by crushing it in your bag. The strap was the only thing that made me hesitate in ordering it, as it does have a pretty utilitarian look to it, and I was worried that it might be too thick and chafe, but it is actually more attractive in person than I was expecting, and it is very comfortable, either over the shoulder or worn cross-body. At this price point, it is a very good value for the money, and I think it will be my new go-to bag (at least until I wear it into the ground by beating it up). If you are on the fence and considering it, I would definitely suggest you go for it. I am actually strongly considering going back and getting the pink one as well!

The CRZ white yoga tank is a fantastic blend of comfort, style, and performance. The fabric is buttery-soft, lightweight, and breathable — perfect for everything from hot yoga to casual wear. It has just the right amount of stretch, offering a snug yet non-restrictive fit.

These are also the perfect solution if you don’t want to break the bank on workout or tennis tanks. They look great, perform well, and are ideal for team uniforms, clinics, or building an affordable on-court wardrobe. Stylish, functional, and such a great value. I’ll definitely continue buying these.

Pros: Inexpensive, soft, lightweight and comfortable. The tank is well vented so you feel dry and cool during your workout. The tank stretches nicely and stays in place well. It doesn’t shrink or fade during washing (even washing in warm water). I ordered a size small and it definitely fits true to size.

Cons: The reason I gave it 4 stars… it has nothing to hold it in place at the bottom of the tank. The bottom will stretch out and will not go back into place. I am fine with a looser stretch as the tank overall stays in place during my workouts, but if you don’t like a stretch it may not be the tank for you.

Overall, I would recommend and I will be purchasing more!

This Calvin Klein long sleeve surplice wrap mini dress is absolutely stunning and very flattering. The wrap style with the buckle detail cinches the waist beautifully and creates a sleek, polished silhouette. It’s the perfect balance of classy and sexy.

I ordered a size 4 in black, and the fit is spot on...tailored without feeling tight. The fabric feels high quality, smooth, and comfortable, with just enough structure to hold its shape. The long sleeves add elegance, making it great for cooler weather, work events, dinners, or nights out.

This dress looks sophisticated and timeless, exactly what you’d expect from Calvin Klein. It’s easy to style with heels or boots and instantly makes you feel put-together and confident. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a chic, versatile statement dress! Worth every penny!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on January 29, 2026
reviews.author: Jenn

reviews.title: Classic flattering style, but thin material
reviews.body:
Finally slipped into this casual holiday dress for an afterwork end of year event. Black velvet drape is a timeless classic: dressy enough for candlelight dinners, casual cocktails, and still modest enough for family gatherings or school recitals.
For the price and designer label, I anticipated a much thicker, heavier velvet material. It’s not as well made as the price implies, so the thinner, stretchier style of this business casual dress is underwhelming. The fit is true to size at least, but cannot be tightened or loosened at the clasp since it zips in the back. Although it has a wrap dress design, the dress is not a true wrap dress.

reviews.body: Love the classic style and the fit of this dress. The tweed fabric is very soft and the collar addsa nice updated touch. This dress is easy to style, the black and white can carry you through all seasons, sleeveless for the summer with nice sandals and you can add a sweater or blazer for colder weather. Very appropriate for a business meeting, church or any occasion where you need a more conservative style. A nice pair of pearl earrings to give it a higher end look, or a pair of red heels and a bag, it's so pretty you don't need much to make this dress pop. Very well constructed dress, the cut is very flattering. Love the contrasting white color of the neck. Excellent value.

I love this dress so much, and if I could give it more stars, I would! Calvin Klein dresses have been some of my favorite work dresses. They always look perfectly tailored and structured. This dress is a perfect example of that. It fits like a glove and is made of very high quality materials that will last a long time if cared for properly. I love the tweed material, which in this case is soft and not scratchy. It is lightweight and breathable with just the right amount of stretch. The zipper was smooth and didn't catch on the material at all. The pockets in the front are more like one long pocket, they are not separated, but accessible from either side, almost like a hand warmer. The collar gives it that perfect retro chic but polished look. For reference, I am wearing a size 2 and I am 5'5" amd 114 lbs. Highly recommend!

I got this well-made, versatile dress for my daughter, and she looks lovely in it. You could easily style it up or down and she says it is quite comfortable. The cut is flattering and it seems to fit true to size. However, we're not so sure about the hoodie-style front pocket. While it seems cute and convenient, it doesn't lay perfectly flat and is visible in the most unfortunate way (almost like she's wearing bulky underwear). Also, she stepped into the dress and nearly got her foot caught in the pocket as it isn't attached to the dress at the top. At the time of this review, this dress is selling for more than $115. I don't know that I think the value is there at that price point.

reviews.body: I live this cost! It is light weight, yet duper warm! I ended up with an XL and am glad because it gives me room for extra layers- I would say sizing is right on point. I love the hood as it stays in place yet isn’t too bulky. All in all a great coat and excellent price!

Took a trip to NYC recently. I wanted a longer coat but wanted something light weight due to traveling. I ordered this coat but sized up from 2x, to 3x just incase it ran small. I would say it is at least true to size if not a little large. I would have exchanged for the 2x or maybe even xl after trying on. I have large biceps and often coats are tight for me there. I was able to wear several layers and felt comfortable with sweater and sweatshirt. The coat kept me very warm and even felt comfortable with just wearing a long sleeve shirt. I am 5’5 and typically wear 2x shirt and 18-20 bottoms. I didn’t test it out much but it seems to withstand water as well. The sleeves were just slightly too long for me but have small elastic band at end so that helped. Loved the navy color and matches well with accessories. Packs up easy and I could fit the whole coat in a backpack style purse if needed.

I honestly really liked this coat it was just too big for me. The color is beautiful and Columbia is a name I trust as my winter jacket is from them and have had it for years. Keeps me toasty. This had the same mining. I will probably reorder in a smaller size.

reviews.body: Love, love this fleece. The fleece is so warm and soft and I constantly reach for it during winter. It is well designed with a function zipper and zipper pockets. It layers nicely and I have washed it several times and the softness and cozy material are all intact. I purchased this on sale - would buy again. I purchased one size up for a more baggy cozy feel but could have gone with my regular size without issue.

The color is exactly as pictured. Fits perfectly. I typically wear a medium sized shirt so I ordered the large in this so I could wear it over bulky clothes. It fits perfectly. Extremely soft and cozy. Seems well made. Columbia has nice quality merchandise. I ordered this to replace a Columbia jacket that I have had for about 8 years. The zipper finally broke on my old one. Columbia's prices tend to be a bit higher than some but their products last a good long while.

It’s not the most thick per se but it’s really warm. I love these jackets a lot. The pattern is super cute and they stay really nice and soft even after washing. I tend to size up for a larger fit but these truly are true to size. I got this on sale so the price was awesome. It’s not super fluffy where it looks tacky either.

products.search_term: Columbia Women's Mountain Croo™ III Mid Down Jacket

reviews.body:
I spent years looking for a waterproof insulated winter jacket that’s also light and allows good freedom of motion for PNW. This is the one, the search is finally over!!
I first tried an older beautiful red color version on at REI 3 years ago, but they didn’t have my size. So last year I got a dark green from Columbia store directly, a bit bummed about the red color being unavailable anymore. My mom tried my jacket on and instantly wanted one too, so we got an agreement that she can keep my green one if I can find a color I like better. This year I found it in pink here, and I love it!!! Now both me and my mom are cozy and dry this winter.
Highly recommend, it’s comfortable, warm, waterproof, great hood and pockets, and it looks great too!

reviews.body: This is the perfect mid weight jacket for where I reside in the Midwest. It’s good for temperatures 30+ and above.

Columbia jackets are always top quality, and I had to replace a jacket because I lost weight. Was hesitant about the blue/green color, I receive compliments every time I wear it. Not a bulky jacket and yet it still keeps me warm without overheating. I ordered size Small (5' 6" and 115#).
Perfect jacket. Super lightweight and versatile and extremely warm!

products.product_name: Women's Joy Peak™ II Mid Hooded Jacket
products.search_term: Columbia Women's Joy Peak™ II Mid Hooded Jacket

reviews.body: Both my daughter and two granddaughters love this coat. The extra length provides protection and warmth to their knees in really cold weather. It is light weight, but provides great warmth. This coat runs true to size. It was a good buy for all three.

This jacket has become my new preferred choice. I appreciate the fit and the weight, as it provides warmth and sufficient length. The thumb hole feature effectively keeps the sleeves in place. It appears to be constructed from high-quality materials. I would certainly consider purchasing this jacket in a different color.

I am 5'7", 126 lbs., 36B and a normal size 4 (sometimes 2 with vanity sizing). I ordered this in Small in the collegiate navy based on reviews that it ran a little small. In brands like Eddie Bauer and Land's End I wear XS for reference. The fit DOES run a little small but it fit perfectly with one polar fleece underneath. If you are larger than a 36B, you should size up as the chest DOES seem to run small. I have a Columbia heavenly long jacket in small and it does run larger than this. This one is roomier through the hips though with plenty of room for movement. I really like the length but see how it could be unflattering for shorter people as it is pear shaped. The thumbholes and fleece around the hood are a nice feature. It will be several months before I see how warm it is but look forward to wearing it. The hood is not removable but that wasn't a dealbreaker for me.

products.product_name: Women's Suttle Mountain™ Long Insulated Jacket
products.search_term: Columbia Women's Suttle Mountain™ Long Insulated Jacket

reviews.body:
Absolutely love this jacket. It’s warm without feeling bulky, super comfortable, and perfect for everyday wear in cooler weather. The fit is flattering and true to size, and the quality is exactly what you’d expect from Columbia. I really appreciate how lightweight it feels while still keeping me cozy. It looks great dressed up or casual, and I’ve gotten so much use out of it already. Zipper quality is awesome YKK… IYKYK!!! Definitely recommend if you want something stylish, practical, and well-made. It has 2 decent size pockets and one breast pocket, could have done better with the amount of pockets and depth, but functional overall.
For reference I am 5’5” 160 lbs and I ordered a size large and I had plenty of extra room to layer underneath if needed.
This coat was really warm! Purchased for 15° weather. It kept me dry and warm and wasn’t overly bulky. It fit over my many layers as well. I like that it was long and able to cover my thighs.

This coat is beautiful. It is heavier than I usually wear and is water resistant. The hood is huge and I have a head that is on the higher end of average (over 22 inches). The color is very vibrant and it both zips and buttons with huge pockets in the front and a zipper pocket on the breast which is plenty big enough for a phone. No pockets on the inside, which I wish it had since I will be traveling in the winter in Europe and that would keep my passport and money safer. This coat is not for temperatures above freezing in my opinion (but I live in a northern state and am used to the cold). It is also longer than the usual winter jacket, which is great. I may update after spending some time in very cold weather.

reviews.body: I really like this jacket! I've worn it in 10 degree weather here in Michigan and it keeps me warm. It's not bulky and puffy like all these puffer coats. It's very easy to put on, warm, has a nice hood, and inside pocket and zipper pockets, also with the loops in the sleeves for your hands to go through! Well worth the price! Fast shipping, too! I purchased the black, size 2X. The quality is the best, and sizing is perfect. Keeps me very warm. I'm 5'5", 190 lbs., and 46 bust, and about 48 hips. I like some room in my clothing. The only thing I wish this jacket had was an alternative of snapping also with the zipper. Other than that....it's the perfect Winter in Michigan jacket!! Perfect length, too!
Fits perfect and love the color! Great light weight coat but also keeps you warm!

I needed a warm and water resistant coat for a winter trip to NYC. I had my eye on this coat for a while, but originally ordered a less expensive, different brand of coat from a competitor store. They sent me the wrong coat, so I came back to this one. I have a thin Columbia windbreaker that I love, so was hoping this would be THE COAT.

Y'all. It's *almost* perfect. It's not bulky at all, but it is incredibly - surprisingly - warm. I loved the longer length and the sleeves with the thumbholes. I'm around 5'6", size 10 women's and ordered a large. I was easily able to layer a baselayer t-shirt and a medium weight sweater underneath and i didn't feel like the poor kid all bundled up in "A Christmas Story." The inside zipper pocket was *chef's kiss* for stashing my tiny zip wallet and OMNY card as we went about our day. It is sleek and not like an enormous puffer coat , so if I did take it off indoors to carry it was lightweight and wasn't like lugging around a king size down comforter.

The only, and I mean only, negative was that putting the hood on and zipping all the way up was a bit uncomfortable. I opted for a hat so that didn't pose an issue. It honestly was not enough of an issue for me to dock a star - it's that great of a coat!

Hoping it lasts through several winters and more travels!

reviews.body:
I had a Columbia winter coat but it was time for a new one. I spent some time looking around and found 2 that I liked. This was one of them. I ended up getting both. This as a lightweight winter coat for those not quite so cold days. The other is for those days when it's freezing outside.

Since I've had Columbia coats before, I knew that my frame (5'2", 110lbs, bra size of 34 A) would fit best in an XS, so that's what I ordered. It arrived quickly, packaged well and fit exactly as it should. I love that it isn't bulky and is a bit more form fitting, but I can still wear a sweater underneath without feeling constricted. The zippers glide easily and it has pockets that are deep enough to hold my phone.

It's comfortable and flattering but also great at blocking the wind and dealing with colder temps. There is no hood on this, so if it's raining out, you'll need a different coat or a hat if you don't want your hair to get wet.

As I stated above, this is a lightweight jacket that is great for temperatures around 40 degrees and above. Once it dips below that around here, I grab my other Columbia coat that is better suited for below freezing weather.
Light weight puffer, super cute can be a dressed up or more casual. Even with it being a not so puffy puffer the heat holding liner keeps you warm in the cold.

Excellent in all ways. I am 5'7", 180 lbs and a large fits perfectly. Can layer a sweatshirt underneath comfortably.
It's the perfect fit, great color, provides needed warmth in the winter!!! Great timing on the shipping as well!

reviews.body:
I love it. It's light weight so I can wear it most of the year. I live in the southern region of the USA so the summer temperatures can be brutal. The coat is well made, stylish, and great price. It has 2 outside pockets and 2 inside that are roomy. I can fit my wallet, car keys, etc. , with room to spare. The last thing I want to do when a deluge of rain hits is carry a purse and I don't have to with the generous pocket space. I also don't need and umbrella as the hood on this coat thoroughly covers my head and keeps me dry.
I'm very happy with my purchase and look forward to wearing it for many years.

I had a black one of these that I’ve used for 5 years or more and it is still going strong. I use it so much all year long I decided I wanted another in a fall color. Got one on a pumpkin orange color. Fits perfectly exactly as the black. Very good nearly all year long. Keeps on warmth when zippered up to the chin. Adjustable wrists and nice foldable hoodie. Rainproof. Easy to wash. Love.
Light weight and waterproof ! Its neat that the hoodie can took in and out. Also protected very well against high winds.

reviews.body: Fits true to size, form fitting shape, longer torso length for warmth, with hood for extra protection. Great layering item during frigid temps to wear under my winter parka which is also from Columbia. Versatile spring and fall coat too.

Bought as a gift for my mother. Very soft and nice quality that you expect in a Columbia fleece. This is longer than the standard fleece and it has a hood! My mom loves the hood and said she has been asked twice in public where she got a Columbia fleece with a hood! Washed well and keeps her warm. I am watching out to get one for myself!

Love the coat. This coat is true to size.
I am 5'4" around 200 lbs. I bought a 2X. The coat is cozy and love that it zips up. I think I could possibly have gotten a XL but thinking that I may wear a sweatshirt or sweater underneath it gives me the extra room. It fits well and does not make me look too boxy like some coats. I feel it is made to be loose and comfortable but also to show our curves and waistline. The only con is that the sleeves are too long for me. This is always an issue for me so I always just roll up the sleeves because I am just 5'4" and kind of chunky so my arms are shorter. I think somebody with longer arms that are probably 5'6" or taller the arms would work great. So give it try.

products.search_term: Columbia Women's Eastmoreland™ Lined Long Jacket

reviews.body:
I've ordered this specific Columbia jacket style in size XXL twice but in different colors. This review is going to be for the Razzle coat. It does run larger than the Black color, although they are the same size.

This jacket does have a lot of positives to it, namely, that it covers my bottom and it's a great price for a longer, lightweight rain jacket. The inner lining has a cottonish/rayonish/ kind of velvety feeling fabric so it seems breathable and provides a little bit of warmth, but it's not as easy as sliding on as say a mesh lining or plastic lining would be. The zipper slides up and down easily. The hood covers my head and hair, but I wish the adjusters were different...they are kind of flat and you have to pinch to adjust. It's an attractive shape on my figure for a raincoat, and it has a slight flare at the bottom. I didn't notice much noise from the outer material.

The cons for me are the sleeves are very long, almost covering my fingertips. They are also quite large, almost frumpy looking. I'm 5'8, around a size US 14/16 with wide hips and carry weight in my lower belly. I'm not busty. This color comfortably fit around my stomach/hip area and accommodated that area nicely when sitting down and I didn't fear the zipper would split. I tried this on with a light/medium density sweater.

I wasn't able to test the efficacy as I returned it. I may try another color and see if it fits comfortably around the stomach area while not looking frumpy elsewhere. I'm also attaching photos of a few other Columbia styles I've tried on. Hope this helps someone trying to find an attractive, yet affordable raincoat.

I bought this jacket so I can walk in our Seattle rain. It’s lined but not a heavy jacket. It keeps we warm and dry but I don’t overheat in it on my walks. Style and quality is spot on. Normally it drizzles a lot where I live. This jacket fits me perfectly. The hat keeps the rain out of my face. I got it on sale for $29. Great value for the money. Definitely recommend it. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I am a true to size XL/14 to 16 depending on the brand and I ordered a 2X and it fit PERFECTLY. I’m so glad I read the review to size up because it does run small. That being said, it’s perfect for cold California weather. Very lightweight, lining is soft and comfortable and great for drizzle weather. Folds up nicely, not bulky at all and covers my bum and hips but still looks flattering. I probably can’t wear a bulky sweater under this, but it’s great for T-shirts underneath or a thin, long sleeve. Definitely keeping and recommending this. Worth the money!

products.search_term: Columbia Women's Castle Dale™ Full Zip Fleece Jacket

reviews.body: My mom has one in pink, and it looked nice, so I bought one. This jacket looks exactly as shown. It's thick, fuzzy, and really warm, not a light spring jacket. The cut is flattering (curvy but not tight in the waist). The quality is great (what you'd expect from Columbia) and is easy to wash (although I hang-dry mine because it's black and I hang dry all my black clothes in case they fade). reviews.body:
I wore this dress for Valentine’s Day dinner with my boyfriend and it was absolutely perfect! The fit is so flattering and hugs in all the right places without feeling uncomfortable. If you’re looking for a dress that’s sophisticated, flattering, and perfect for a special date night or event, this is it. I felt confident, elegant, and beautiful all night. Highly recommend! 💕

Highly recommend if you’re looking for a sleek, stylish dress that feels as good as it looks!

reviews.body: I purchased the dark green one and really liked the top. The fit is tight and snug but has some stretch to it. I thought about having it taken up but that would cost more for alterations and tbh I don’t even need a dress right now so I’m returning it. The Hunter green color was also pretty dull and muted. Overall it’s a nice dress and stylish and I could have easily made this work with some alterations but I bought it even though I don’t have an occasion for it because it was not expensive. The material was very nice and heavy and like I said, the top was fitted and snug and I am smaller up top and would have loved wearing it without a bra. Such a bummer but if you like tea length dresses and are smaller up top - this would be a total hit. Worth a try - they have free returns!

What a great dress! I've been fighting with my postpartum body for a couple years now and this dress made me feel fabulous. I ordered a medium at 5'2, 135 and 32DDD-E. I probably could have done with the small, but the coverage in the chest probably would've been a little skimpy, though the waist/bodice was a touch loose in the medium.

I tried and did get my Freya Deco strapless bra hidden under this dress, so if you pull the straps tighter you can get some strapless bras under it. But it did stick out a shade on the edges under my arms so instead I hacked up an old bra and sewed the cups right into the seams of the dress too. It wasn't perfect, but it was a very good solution to the support issue (my girls are... Let's say not where they used to be lol).

The fabric is much nicer than I expected, it's not a cheap cotton/poly sundress, and it was 100% opaque but very light and breezy. It came to mid calf on me cause I'm short, and I like it so much I actually may drop the cash to have it shortened a hair and have the waist taken in, and have someone who's a better seamstress than me sew in the cups.

Overall, this dress is a winner. I wore it to a casual beach wedding and got compliments on it all night. This one's worth taking the chance on and I'll be looking at other offerings from this brand in the future.

Honestly I wasn’t sure what I was going to get out of this because the material and of some products on Amazon vary so much and I never have luck with buying clothes on here. BUT, I love this dress. I’m 5’2 102lb and got an extra small. It fits great and the straps are adjustable, which allows you to have the V in the front as deep as you would like. Some women on here complained that it’s a dress meant for women with boobs. I’m a pretty flat 34b and it’s good for me.

However, I definitely want to mention that I bought this dress in the green and navy colors in the same size on the same day to see which color I would like best. I tried on the navy first and I really liked it, but I felt like it wasn’t tight enough in the back like it could go in an inch. Then I tried on the green and it was perfect. I’m giving this Tommy Hilfiger jumpsuit 4 stars because the quality is beautiful, but the pattern doesn’t work well for my body proportions.

The construction is solid too, seams are neat, the belt is a nice touch, and overall it looks like a polished, dressy piece that could easily work for holidays or evening events.

I sized up from my usual size and that was definitely the right choice; the jumpsuit fits comfortably and the length of the pants is perfect. I’m 5'9" with a longer torso, and the leg length is actually fantastic! Long, chic, and very flattering with heels. The problem is the upper portion: the torso of the jumpsuit is cut quite short, so on a long‑torso body it rides up and feels awkward.

Because the bodice is so short, the proportions look a bit strange on me: the waist seam sits too high, and it creates the impression of super long legs with a very compressed upper body. For my frame it’s noticeable and slightly uncomfortable when moving or sitting. I love the fabric and overall design concept, but I wish the body length were at least a couple of inches longer.

Overall, I’d still recommend this jumpsuit for the quality, fabric, and statement look, especially if you’re not long‑torsoed. Just be aware that if, like me, you have a longer body and are around 5'9" or taller, the top may feel too short even if the pant length and general size fit perfectly.

There are outfits you wear, and then there are outfits that change the way you carry yourself. This Tommy Hilfiger jumpsuit falls firmly into the second category.

The moment I slipped it on; I felt that quiet spark of confidence — the kind that comes from knowing your outfit is doing half the work for you. The shimmer jersey bodice has this soft, luminous glow that feels elegant without trying too hard. It stretches gently with the body, thanks to the polyester spandex blend, so you never feel restricted. The surplice neckline adds a touch of sophistication that’s flattering without being fussy.

Then you get to the scuba crepe pants — smooth, structured, and surprisingly comfortable. They fall beautifully with the 32-inch inseam, giving the whole silhouette a long, clean line. Paired with the faux leather belt, the look feels modern, intentional, and pulled together in a way that works for so many moments in life.

What I love most is how easy it is. This is the kind of piece you reach for when you want to look polished but don’t want to overthink it. Dinner out, a work event, a holiday gathering, even travel days — it transitions effortlessly. It’s simple, stylish, and unmistakably Tommy Hilfiger in that classic, dependable way.

Very well made men’s track jacket! The sleeves were a little too short for my husband though, so we had to return it. I’m giving it 5 stars because my 6’3” husband has very long arms & struggles finding clothes that fit. Otherwise this jacket is really nice. The material seems very high quality.

The complimentary and analogous color choices of these jackets from dioxoib make it clear that someone with definite skill was in charge of that aspect of design. They have chosen compelling colors which are shades of primary colors, but far more interesting. Rather than the same tired hues we might expect, we are treated to surprising and unexpected shades.

The fabric is smooth and slick, the kind which might repel rain rather than absorb it. There isn't much lining, so I wouldn't have any illusions that the jacket will provide much warmth in cold weather, but still might be enough to mitigate a slight chill.

In terms of size, I ordered a 2x which runs smaller than most garments of that size. My son wears a large to extra large and this 2X fits him perfectly. He commented that the item has a slimming effect and for him that is true. It does. On me, because it is too tight, it accentuates my pudge.

Oddly, the zipper slider and teeth are on the opposite side one might expect. Come to think of it, maybe that accounts for why this jacket is not true to size. Even though the listing refers to the garment as a men's garment, maybe is was designed for a woman, since women's zippers are opposite of men's. For these reasons, I'm giving this item four stars, not the five I would otherwise give it.
